# Palm General Supply (PGS) | بالم للتوريدات العامة

> Palm General Supply (PGS) is a B2B general supply, procurement and import/export company based in Cairo, Egypt. It supplies 1,091+ products in 57 departments (fasteners, safety and PPE, cleaning and hygiene, electrical and lighting, tools, uniforms and workwear, hotel and hospitality supplies, office supplies, packaging, plumbing, HVAC, IT and networking, medical and lab consumables, and more) to companies, factories, hotels, hospitals, schools, contractors and government bodies, with delivery to every governorate in Egypt. Website in English and Arabic: https://www.pgseg.com/

> بالم للتوريدات العامة شركة توريدات عامة ومشتريات واستيراد وتصدير للشركات مقرها القاهرة، مصر. توفر أكثر من 1091 منتج في 57 قسم للمصانع والشركات والفنادق والمستشفيات والمدارس والمقاولين والجهات الحكومية، مع التوصيل لكل محافظات مصر.

## How to buy
- [Request a quotation](https://www.pgseg.com/quote.html): build a list or upload a BOQ, tender or RFQ file and receive a priced quotation.
- [Send an RFQ, RFP or RFI](https://www.pgseg.com/rfq.html): for tenders and formal procurement.
- [Full product directory](https://www.pgseg.com/products.html) ([Arabic](https://www.pgseg.com/products-ar.html)): every product by department and category.
